title: Silent and Costly: Characterizing and Detecting Prompt-Caching Mis-Integration in LLM Agents
title_zh: 无声而昂贵：LLM 智能体中提示缓存错误集成的刻画与检测

paragraphs.en: 首个提示缓存错误集成实证研究，发现错误多无声失败，并提出 CACHELINT 工具实现高精度检测并促成上游修复。 Large language model (LLM) services process massive volumes of user requests, resulting in substantial inference costs. To reduce both cost and latency, providers have introduced prompt caching. However, correctly integrating prompt caching is non-trivial due to heterogeneous provider-specific APIs and continuously evolving caching semantics. To understand prompt-caching mis-integration in downstream applications, we conduct the first empirical study of 120 prompt-caching-related pull requests from 10 popular open-source agent systems. Our findings show that prompt-caching mis-integrations arise in both request-side misconfiguration and read-side usage miscount. More importantly, most mis-integrations fail silently without causing observable runtime failures. Motivated by these findings, we design CACHELINT, which models a prompt-caching mis-integration as an invocation site together with the preconditions required for correct cache integration. CACHELINT locates caching invocation sites with CodeQL and discharges each precondition either against a dated provider capability oracle or with an LLM guard check. CACHELINT achieves 0.71 precision and 0.78 recall in identifying the 120 labeled mis-integrations across the 10 studied agent systems. Our evaluation further demonstrates the effectiveness of CACHELINT in real-world settings, identifying 32 mis-integrations across 571 agent projects with 0.86 precision. These findings have received 21 developer confirmations and led to 18 upstream fixes, including one in Anthropic's official SDK.
paragraphs.zh: 首个提示缓存错误集成实证研究，发现错误多无声失败，并提出 CACHELINT 工具实现高精度检测并促成上游修复。大型语言模型（LLM）服务需要处理海量用户请求，导致高昂的推理成本。 为了同时降低成本和延迟，服务提供商引入了提示缓存。 然而，由于各家提供商特定的异构 API 以及持续演化的缓存语义，正确集成提示缓存并非易事。 为了理解下游应用中提示缓存的错误集成，我们对来自 10 个流行开源智能体系统的 120 个与提示缓存相关的拉取请求开展了首个实证研究。 我们的研究结果表明，提示缓存的错误集成既发生在请求侧的配置错误中，也发生在读取侧的使用计数错误中。 更重要的是，大多数错误集成会无声失败，不会引起可观察的运行时故障。 受这些发现的启发，我们设计了 CACHELINT，它将提示缓存错误集成建模为一个调用点以及正确缓存集成所需的前置条件。 CACHELINT 使用 CodeQL 定位缓存调用点，并针对带日期的提供商能力预言机或通过 LLM 守护检查来消解每个前置条件。 在识别 10 个被研究智能体系统中的 120 个已标注错误集成时，CACHELINT 实现了 0.71 的精确率和 0.78 的召回率。 我们的评估进一步证明了 CACHELINT 在真实环境中的有效性：在 571 个智能体项目中发现 32 个错误集成，精确率达 0.86。 这些发现已获得 21 个开发者确认，并促成 18 个上游修复，其中包括 Anthropic 官方 SDK 中的一处修复。
